text:
Type: unfinished pine shelf panel
Use: additional shelf for a pine shelving system, holding books, bins and tools; living room, home office, storage room
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: raw solid pine with knots and visible grain, grey-beige metal side rails
Colors: light natural pine, pale honey, grey-beige
Shape: flat rectangular board with square edges, slim metal rails along the short ends for fitting between uprights, plain and sturdy, compact
Feel: honest, warm, natural, utilitarian
Goes with: raw wood, white walls, cotton and jute, plants; rustic, Scandinavian or workshop-style rooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Untreated solid wood is a durable natural material which is even more hardwearing and easy to look after if you oil or wax the surface.
